statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let highLambda := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then 0 else ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∃ (C : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ‖I n (highLambda n) (highLambda n) - I n (high n) (high n)‖ ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ 3

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 高段次弧 · MA-7008 · 在旧次弧高段上用 Mangoldt 权替换素数权
plain_statement.en: New route · High-segment minor arcs · MA-7008 · Replace prime weights by von Mangoldt weights on the high minor-arc segment

brief.zh: 保持原题的弧和立方根高段截止，利用全圆 Parseval 与真素数幂计数把高段次弧双线性积分中的素数权 w 替换为 Λ，误差为 O(n^(3/4) (log n)^3)，供高段 Vaughan 分拆使用。
brief.en: Keep the original arcs and cube-root high-segment cutoff. Use full-circle Parseval and the proper prime-power count to replace w by von Mangoldt Λ in the high-segment minor-arc integral within O(n^(3/4) (log n)^3), preparing Vaughan's identity.
